snapshot.title: Phone Call: Hilltop Transmission Main Break Confirmed

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

transcript.speaker: Distribution On-Call
transcript.text: Control, this is Distribution On-Call. I’ve just returned from the Hilltop Tank site. The sight gauge shows LIT-601 at 11.8 feet and falling. The tank is not visible from the street, but the pressure has dropped to 14 psi. I’ve confirmed the break on the Hilltop Transmission Main near Summit Drive. The zone is now losing pressure. I recommend initiating manual isolation per the Map of Record (MDWS-MAP-2026-1).

transcript.speaker: Incident Commander
transcript.text: Understood. Confirm the break location is near Summit Drive, and the level is falling faster than 1 foot per 20 minutes. Initiate isolation using V-2410 and V-2418. Verify both valves with a second operator. Log the action on Form ERP-2 immediately.

transcript.speaker: Distribution On-Call
transcript.text: Roger. V-2410 and V-2418 will be engaged manually. I’ll confirm with the second operator and begin the log on ERP-2.

transcript.speaker: Incident Commander
transcript.text: Good. Initiate the advisory decision protocol now. The pressure has dropped below 20 psi in Zone 2. Begin sampling per Section 8.3 of the ERP.

snapshot.instructorNote: This is a core narrative inject. The IC must authorize manual isolation using the Map of Record and begin the advisory decision process. Watch for delayed verification or incorrect valve selection.
